prompt: Create an original 60 second gamelan-inspired instrumental instrumental composition for celebration, positive conclusion and project reveal. Mood: hopeful, joyful, uplifting. Instruments: metallophones, soft gong, bamboo flute. Style: cyclic interlocking metallic patterns with long gong punctuation. Tempo approximately 92 BPM; C major. Main idea: an ascending fourth answered by a stepwise descent. Introduce a memorable rising motif, develop it, and end with a confident resolved cadence. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A gentle and melodic instrumental piece featuring a prominent flute melody over a bed of pizzicato and bowed strings, with light percussion. The mood is calm and reflective, reminiscent of a folk or classical chamber ensemble.
description.zh: 一段轻柔而旋律优美的纯音乐，以长笛为主旋律，伴随着拨弦和弓弦乐器，以及轻快的打击乐。氛围平静而富有沉思感，让人联想到民间或古典室内乐团。
